items.title: Register live-smoke transcript as a lifecycle artifact
items.context: Add evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json to the closed lifecycle artifact relative path set so scope gates classify the command-generated TEST artifact as lifecycle_artifact for the same story only.

happy.desc: The exact relative path evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json is registered as a lifecycle artifact path.

edge.desc: Registration is path-specific and does not introduce a broad evidence/ prefix allowlist.

adversarial.desc: Cross-story or arbitrary nested evidence paths remain blocked unless they match the exact same-story lifecycle artifact rule.

items.userSees: Scope gate output classifies .lattice/story/actives/<storyId>/evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json as lifecycle_artifact instead of out_of_scope.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke runner passes and includes live-smoke-transcript as a TEST lifecycle artifact.
No broad evidence/ path allowlist is introduced by this registration.
Command output remains path-specific for same-story evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json only.

items.title: Add fail-closed scope regression coverage
items.context: Extend scope contract/process fact checks so evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json passes, while sibling arbitrary nested evidence such as evidence/notes.md still fails closed.

happy.desc: scope-contract smoke accepts .lattice/story/actives/B-scope/evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json as non-blocking lifecycle_artifact.

edge.desc: Existing transcript-diff lifecycle artifact coverage remains intact.

adversarial.desc: A sibling arbitrary file such as .lattice/story/actives/B-scope/evidence/notes.md still appears as blocking non-lifecycle metadata drift.

items.userSees: The regression smoke prints PASS while accepting live-smoke-transcript.json and rejecting evidence/notes.md.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke accepts .lattice/story/actives/B-scope/evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json as lifecycle_artifact and keeps it non-blocking.
transcript-diff lifecycle artifact behavior remains accepted in the smoke coverage.
Sibling path evidence/notes.md still reports blocking non-lifecycle drift in the smoke runner.

items.title: Update lifecycle artifact scope policy text
items.context: Document live-smoke transcript alongside transcript-diff as a path-specific TEST lifecycle artifact and explicitly retain the no-blanket-evidence-dir invariant.

happy.desc: Policy text names evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json as a path-specific lifecycle artifact alongside evidence/transcript-diff.md.

edge.desc: Policy still states lifecycle artifact admission is closed and registry-backed.

adversarial.desc: Policy explicitly rejects a blanket evidence/ directory exemption for arbitrary nested files.

items.userSees: The lifecycle artifact policy names evidence/live-smoke-transcript.json and still says arbitrary evidence/ files are not lifecycle artifacts.
